payload.title: Report alignment, human effort and actual optimization over time
payload.description:
## Scope and acceptance
Report learning curves by label count and time, Include/Exclude counts, comments, review fraction/propensity, prequential agreement, independently random-audit metrics/intervals, and final sealed holdout score only after freeze. Distinguish model recommendation from fitted-head prediction and training fit from unbiased evaluation. Record rubric/task/example changes, feature counts, refits, proposals accepted/rejected and version changes, latency and returned usage. State selection/anchoring/rubric-drift limitations. Repeated evaluation of permanent holdout may not guide optimization; do not guarantee alignment or no-review operation.
